facts.text: Stanbridge University houses the first SynDaver Synthetic Cadaver Lab on the West Coast for hands-on anatomy and body systems training.

sources.title: Innovative Technology in Healthcare Education | Stanbridge University
sources.quote: Stanbridge University offers the first SynDaver Synthetic Cadaver Lab on the West Coast. Students study lifelike anatomy and body systems in depth which builds accuracy and confidence before clinical practice.
